text: The new adventure is ok, but you're not sure if you like it as much as the last one.
alt: There's a new adventure on the website, titled 'Midnight Crew'. It reads: 'You are members of a sinister gang called the Midnight Crew. Your nefarious plots are serpentine in their complexity. Your schemes, convoluted. You are planning a heist in your underground hideout. What will you do?'
